name: wire
description: WIRE: Wired Interconnect for Register Exchange — software-driven I2C master FSM with internal loopback (no external pins; compositor register bus only)

registers.name: CONTROL
registers.desc: bit 0 = start tx, bit 1 = start rx, bit 2 = reset, bit 3 = stop

registers.name: STATUS
registers.desc: bit 0 = busy, bit 1 = done, bit 2 = nack

registers.name: LOOPBACK
registers.desc: value the simulated slave returns on read
